naibbe.behavior: Reads one local CSV at import; encryption uses Python random, static maps and local text; file writing occurs in main or our wrapper. No network calls in the executed author functions.

published_decryption_assumptions.caution: Our unique-token criterion is stricter than the paper; finding ambiguity is not a novel refutation.

naibbe.strict_adapter: The runtime unigram-rejection set is augmented with 99 nonunique bigram ciphertext forms, identified exhaustively using the official decoder. No mapping or weights changed.
naibbe.side_information_used_by_inverse: Ciphertext tokens and public decoding tables only. Saved truth is used for evaluation, never to choose a decoder alternative.
naibbe.license: Root LICENSE is standard MIT; source headers and README additionally request paper citation. Both preserved verbatim.

timm.behavior: Default curveline/page/slim/top generation uses handwritten glyph rules and generated history; fixed morphological priors were designed by the author using VMS observations.
timm.dictionary_dependency: StatisticHelper originally instantiates VoynichCanFollow and increments whole-VMS membership counters. Source search found those counters used only in printable diagnostics, not generation decisions.
timm.adaptation: Isolated source copy removes the dictionary diagnostic and prints an explicit disabled notice. Original third-party source is untouched; diff saved in build/timm_diagnostic_only.patch.
timm.seed_change: Original seed f103v is in reserve. It is not generated or scored here; use legacy f1r.1 first six certain tokens, remove that copied initial line from scored output.
timm.no_model_tuning: Rates, source choice and morphology remain author defaults. Seeds 19..38 are predeclared; none selected for fit.
timm.currier_branch: A: Config.java lines204–209 selects B only when initial seed contains ed; f1r seed does not. This follows the declared seed substitution, not outcome tuning.

provenance_limitations: Author priors used full-manuscript observations before our study; generated similarity is not an independent held-out validation.
Source text was obtained via GitHub connector and normalized to UTF-8/LF; local SHA256 is recorded, repository commit pins semantic source version.
No original paper-wide Latin/Italian corpus sweep was reproduced.
